main_text.p: mia σωτηρία[?] obtulit Iehouæ. Genes.35.7. Ædificauit ibi altare, uocauitq; locum El Beth-el: quia ibi apparuerat ei Deus, cū fugeret à facie fratris sui Esau.

1. Δοξολογία[?] & gratiarum actio pro beneficijs diuinis. Hebr.13.15. Per ipsum igitur assiduè offeramus Deo sacrificiū laudis, id est, fructum labiorum confitentium nomini eius.Redemtionis enim nostræ, per Christū partæ & peractæ, beneficiū semper nobis grata memoria recolendum, ut nunquā nō agamus Deo gratias,

2. Beneficentia erga pios egenos & oppressos. Eodem cap.uers.16. Beneficen-tiæ uerò & communicationis ne obliuiscimini: talibus enim uictimis delecta-tur Dominus. Prouerb.21.3. Facere iu-sticiā & iudiciū, magis placet Deo quàm sacrificium.

3. Sefe totum Deo confecrare, ac sum-mo studio obediedi Deo flagrare. Rom. 12.1. Precor igitur uos, fratres, per miserationes Dei, ut sistatis corpora uestra hostiam uiuam, sanctam, acceptam Deo, rationalem illum cultum uestrum,

page.notes: Greek words are uncertain: the heading word after "1." and the Greek word at the top of the page (σωτηρία) are read from a small, worn print and are marked [?]. The page number 159 is uncertain: the final digit looks like a long s or f. The signature mark at bottom right is faint and marked [?]. "Benefi-cen-tiæ" at the line end is uncertain in its hyphenation. No marginal notes and no catchword are printed on this page.
